_help: The economy page's 'Uro i økonomien' filled backwards once (the owner, 18/10: 'kan vi fylde uro i økonomien i retrospekt'): stories of the month before 17/10 that the radar's sources had not carried, found with Google News on the scouts' subjects, each with a Danish headline in the editor's style (reality only, who did or said what). src/radar/energy.py merges them into the topic's own memory, which keeps its stories 30 days; they leave by themselves.
